text: works great. The usual, regular cracker... I bought these to supplement my supply at seafood boils.  They are just the right size to crack just about anything.  I find the larger ones to be cumbersome and hard to use with some seafood.  Also, I do wash them in my dishwasher... no harm.  They turn a little tan colored as they age... but doesn't effect their use.
